payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each station, sort candies by clockwise distance (farthest first) to ensure the last delivered candy is the closest, minimizing total cycles. Then compute overall time as max over stations of (arrival time + candies_cycles + min_distance).
payload.rationale: The code sorts candies per station by decreasing distance (greedy order) to minimize added travel after the last full cycle. This directly implements a greedy sorting order strategy.
